mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, title, content, type, is_read AS isRead, create_time AS createTime FROM psy_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} OR user_id IS NULL ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE psy_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM psy_message WHERE (user_id = #{userId} OR user_id IS NULL) AND is_read = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO psy_message (user_id, title, content, type) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type})
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, category, summary, content, author, view_count AS viewCount, status, create_time AS createTime FROM psy_knowledge WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE psy_knowledge SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO psy_knowledge (title, category, summary, content, author) VALUES (#{title}, #{category}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{author})
mapper.select: SELECT record_id AS recordId, user_id AS userId FROM psy_test_record WHERE record_id = #{recordId} LIMIT 1

SELECT r.record_id AS recordId, s.scale_name AS scaleName, s.scale_code AS scaleCode, r.std_score AS stdScore, r.level, r.create_time AS createTime FROM psy_test_record r LEFT JOIN psy_scale s ON r.scale_id = s.scale_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT oper_id AS operId, title, business_type AS businessType, oper_name AS operName, oper_url AS operUrl, oper_ip AS operIp, status, error_msg AS errorMsg, oper_time AS operTime FROM sys_oper_log ORDER BY oper_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT info_id AS infoId, user_name AS userName, ipaddr, status, msg, login_time AS loginTime FROM sys_login_log ORDER BY login_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
